prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic lo-fi gaming-bedroom portrait with cold blue laptop light and deep purple LED ambience, preserving the cyber-grunge tech-heavy atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with colorful clipped pigtails, clear-rimmed glasses reflecting screen light, natural skin texture and a bored but absorbed expression. She lies on her stomach with chin supported in both hands, wearing a ribbed grey knit top, modest dark shorts and headphones around her neck, with white wired earphones loosely around her arms.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 bedroom frame. Place the adult woman on a bed surrounded by an open laptop, multiple glowing screens, RGB keyboard, tangled white and black cables, headphones, generic energy-drink cans and sticker-covered headboard. Keep her face and glasses in focus while feet and distant screens may have slight motion blur.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold blue laptop light and deep purple LED strips create moody high-contrast bloom around the silhouette, with realistic screen glare on glasses and natural digital shadows. Keep the mood nocturnal, intimate, melancholic and unpolished.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical lo-fi digital-camera aesthetic, slightly soft focus, heavy but natural digital grain, saturated blue-purple neon, realistic cable and keyboard detail, screen reflections without readable code or brand text.
